companions.reason_en: Grown together, tomato gave more fruit than when grown alone.
companions.reason_hi: साथ उगाने पर टमाटर की उपज अकेले उगाने से ज़्यादा रही।

relation.title: FAO AGRIS: Growth and yield of tomato in various intercrop combinations (Sarhad Journal of Agriculture, 2004)
relation.quote: their combination gave maximum yield of tomato (27.61 tha-1) compared to that of as a sole crop (20.34 t ha-1)
relation.note: Two summer seasons in Peshawar (Pakistan); not yet tested in Malwa.
